profile.headline: Full-Stack Developer | Software Engineer | React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js | Shopify Plus and Shopify Functions
profile.summary:
Hi! My name is Ryan Lee and I am a self-directed Full Stack Developer and Digital Product Designer bridging technology, design, and e-commerce to create scalable digital experiences that elevate brands, engage users, and drive business growth. Through hands-on experience and continuous learning, I've developed skills across full-stack development, UI/UX, e-commerce, and AI-assisted workflows.

I'm passionate about turning complex ideas into intuitive digital experiences that elevate brands, improve user experiences, and drive business growth. My nontraditional path has taught me to be resourceful, adaptable, and persistent- qualities I bring to every project I take on! 

Wanna know more feel free to message me here on LinkedIn or email me at ryankjra@gmail.com.

Personal website: www.ryanhklee.com

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Promoted twice since joining as a web developer in December 2022.
Designed VoroShip, the in-house operations platform, with the CEO and the warehouse, support and phone teams, and built it as a single Node, Prisma and PostgreSQL app that replaced the company's WMS and ERP, Narvar, Tally and Quo.
Built its order-tracking API and checkout extension, the multi-carrier rate engine with freight routing, the scan-to-ship gate and an MCP server that gives AI agents scoped access to the platform.
Built My Garage, a passwordless portal for warranty registration, order and claim tracking, service requests and a forum.
Built the Rust Shopify Function and admin rules editor behind every checkout's shipping rates, plus liftgate and tracking extensions.
Designed and run the team's AI delivery pipeline. Multi-agent Claude Code workflows, MCP tooling, spec to tested pull request.
In 2026 the storefront's interactions got 63% faster (INP), 10 third-party tools were replaced and VoroShip shipped 900 releases since June.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Moved into server-side work. Built REST, GraphQL and webhook integrations for Shopify, carriers, partner platforms and internal services.
Wrote the API routes, webhook handlers, auth and security behind those integrations.
Implemented Mabang, an ERP and warehouse management system, for the US warehouse's orders, inventory, purchase orders and SKU catalog.
Owned technical SEO and site speed, from structured data and metadata to Core Web Vitals, crawl and index control.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Joined as the company's web developer, responsible for its Shopify Plus storefront.
Owned the theme code in Liquid, JavaScript and CSS and built product, landing and campaign pages with the marketing team.
Integrated and maintained third-party apps and trackers for reviews, financing, warranties, chat, analytics and affiliates.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
- Designed and developed a fully responsive website from concept through deployment
- Built interactive front-end experiences utilizing HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and PHP
- Translated design concepts into functional, user-focused web interfaces
- Managed website hosting and deployment through Linux/cPanel
- Optimized Site Structure and functionality to support a seamless user experience.

company.name: S&S Labor Force dba JRM Security

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Developed responsive, user-focused websites using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and WordPress CMS.
- Collaborated with design-focused teams to translate creative concepts and mockups into functional digital experiences.
- Designed and customized unique web pages aligned with brand identity, usability, and business objectives.
- Bridged design and development to create cohesive, engaging, and intuitive user experiences.

positions.title: Shopify Web Developer
positions.description:
- Developed and launched a Shopify e-commerce experience for a startup, supporting its digital presence and business growth.
- Customized storefront functionality using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Shopify Liquid.
- Implemented core e-commerce features including product browsing, cart, checkout, and payment functionality.
- Translated business and brand goals into a functional, user-friendly online shopping experience.

projects.title: Bomb Desk
projects.description: A typing battle royale for up to eight players. Play solo against seven bots, or open a room and send friends the link. Make three typos, run out of time on a line or finish a round last, and the device on your desk cuts one of its six wires. One is live.

projects.title: Ticket Atlas LA
projects.description: 3.9 million LA parking tickets from two years on a 3D hexagon map. Drag the clock through an average week, or click a hexagon for its worst hours.
